op-tgrx-continuum-generalized-entropy.physical_scope: A precisely delimited open problem for a selected four-dimensional semiclassical Einstein-scalar collapse model, an actually existing smooth solution on a stated globally hyperbolic domain, a Hadamard state, and a fixed covariant renormalization prescription. It asks for sufficient nonperturbative-in-the-scalar-amplitude conditions for finite, regulator-independent generalized-entropy differences and their future monotonicity. It asserts no solution existence, entropy convergence, regulator independence, generalized second law, or empirical result.
